# MovieHeight

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Movies](BlitzBasic-Movies)

```blitzbasic
MovieHeight movie%  ; returns Int
```

**Works in:** Blitz2D, BlitzPlus, Blitz3D

The height of the pictures of a movie in pixels.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `movie` | Int | required | A movie handle from [OpenMovie](OpenMovie). |

**Returns:** The height in pixels.

**Differences and known gaps:**

* Returns 0, because no movie can be opened.
